newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin sees Pt Beach nuke back Sun/Mon.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin sees Pt Beach nuke back Sun/Mon.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co said its 485 megawatt Point Beach 1 nuclear unit would likely be reconnnected to the electricity grid Sunday or Monday following repairs.
"We're making changes to a backup emergency diesel generator. That should be done Friday, and we will probably be back on grid either Sunday or Monday," company spokeswoman Jackie Olson said.
The Point Beach unit, in Two Rivers, Wisc., was shut Feb 18 to repair a cooling system pump.
The adjacent unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, is scheduled to restart around April 12 following a refueling outage that began last October.
Wisconsin Electric is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
